text:
Ravi (new-hire): morning! quick q on Notion -- trying to set up my ramp notes and copy the RFC template. I can see the pages but can't copy some templates ("view only"). who handles template permissions?

sam_peopleops: welcome Ravi :tada: Templates are in Notion > Company Home > Templates > Team Templates. edit/duplicate rights depend on the page's parent space. DM me your email and I'll add you to the appropriate group.

mj_docs: Hi! If you hit view-only, click "Request access" which creates a ticket. If you add a short reason like "ramp + will copy RFC template" and ping @mj_docs I can pre-approve faster. Also note some templates are set to "Duplication restricted" to preserve canonical copies.

Ravi (new-hire): thanks! my email is ravi@redwood.com. btw is there a preferred place to store personal ramp notes that others can see later?

taylor_eng: we usually keep personal ramps in Eng > Ramps if you want teammates to reference them. naming conv: "first-last (team) - ramp" for shared, "first-last - ramp" for private. add a one-line summary at the top and tag the primary mentor.

mj_docs: small heads-up: when you copy an RFC template, replace the metadata block at top (owner/created date) and remove any team-private links. if you need to move a copied page into a different space, ping me so I can ensure links don't break.

Ravi (new-hire): got it. can templates be copied to my personal workspace? i'd like a private copy first.

mj_docs: yes, you can duplicate into your private workspace as long as the template allows duplication. if duplication is blocked, request a copy and note "for personal ramp". we'll usually grant it.

docs-bot: docs-requests - ticket DR-7712 created for ravi@redwood.com (requested by sam_peopleops). Link: https://notion.company/requests/DR-7712

sam_peopleops: added Ravi to Engineering Editors. you should get the Notion invite shortly.

Ravi (new-hire): invite arrived, thanks! copying RFC now. one last tiny q 14 are there any naming conventions for RFC drafts vs final RFCs?

taylor_eng: prefix drafts with "WIP -" and put them in Eng > RFCs > Drafts. when final, remove WIP and move to Eng > RFCs > Published. include a one-line summary and set the status tag (Draft/Review/Final).

Ravi (new-hire): perfect, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
